content: State of CSS 2025: Tailwind 37% usage vs Bootstrap 21.6%, higher satisfaction. But Bootstrap 5 ships ready-made components (navbar, tables, modals, pagination, badges) ideal for admin/dashboard CRUD UIs and reaches usable state in days — recommended for rapid builds/MVPs with tight timelines; Tailwind favored for custom-branded, scalable enterprise UIs but requires more setup (build step, component composition).
